name: SettingRow
purpose: A settings line: a title, an optional description, a control slot, an optional footnote, and an optional read-only value. Covers the stacked control rows (Theme, Capture mode, Saved to, Data folder, Restore defaults), the inline toggle rows (Show completed tasks, Reduced motion), the read-only app info line (version on the right), and the shortcut rows (the keycap is HotkeyControl in the control slot; a rebind error shows in the footnote). Folded from A's ShortcutRow. Sources: A and B. Folds in RefineRow: RefineRow becomes a SettingRow whose control slot holds a size-sm Segmented, which SettingRow's entry already lists in its slot. Add a leading icon slot and an inline layout. Both are role=group labelled by their label. Medium confidence (A): filter predicates and settings are different domains, but the job (a label plus a control in a panel) is the same.
base: none (layout only). The control slot takes Radix Switch for toggles, the library Segmented, PathButton and Button, and HotkeyControl.

values.when: Title and description on the left; control or read-only value on the right. Used by Show completed tasks and Reduced motion (Toggle), the app info row (value, no control), and the shortcut rows (HotkeyControl).

Control on its own full-width line under the title and description. Used by Theme (Segmented), Capture mode (Segmented, no description, has a footnote), Saved to and Data folder (PathButton), and Restore defaults (Button).
h-8 row (295x28 at 873,252 / 284 / 315); label 500 13px/19.5px; icon 15px weight 300.

props.name: title
props.description: Setting name (for example 'Theme', 'Show completed tasks', 'Taskscape'). The control is labelled by it.

props.name: description
props.description: Supporting text. Absent on Capture mode.

props.name: footnote
props.description: Note under the row: the Reduced motion force note, the Capture mode note, or the rebind error line for shortcut rows (shortcutsPane.tsx:18-23).

props.name: control
props.description: Radix Switch (Toggle), Segmented, PathButton, Button or HotkeyControl.

props.name: value
props.description: Read-only trailing text, used for the app version (B's read-only value prop).

states: search-only (shown alone as the only search result)
role: group labelled by the title when a control is present; no role for read-only rows. The footnote is linked by aria-describedby. The rebind error role is open (alert or polite live region).
keyboard: The row itself is not focusable. Focus goes to the control in DOM order.
platform: Same on web and desktop: Theme, Show completed tasks, Reduced motion, Restore defaults. Desktop only: Capture mode, Saved to and Data folder (PathButton opens a local folder), and the capture shortcut rows (Screenshot capture, Capture bar, Clear capture draft). Web drops these (no capture, no local folder; files are on the server). App info copy: the reference reads 'A macOS task manager with a menu-bar capture bar.'; the web copy must not mention the menu bar capture, and Windows desktop needs its own copy.
open: 1) Restore defaults: the control variant is not recorded. If it resets all settings, should it use the danger colour (destructive actions use danger)? 2) The stacked and inline layouts are a visible difference, so both are kept as the layout axis. 3) The web replacement for the Data folder row is not decided. 4) The rebind error footnote's live-region role is open (alert or polite). 5) Shortcut row height: 36px measured (35px on some last rows). 36px is about 2.5714rem at 1rem=14px; A's 'about 2.5rem' equals 35px. B folds this to min-height and treats the 1px difference as measurement error. Confirm min-height versus fixed 36px. 6) The error line colour is not decided; danger is decided for destructive actions only (A). 7) Web default bindings must not collide with browser shortcuts; default key values are not in the catalogue (B). 8) Dropped from A's ShortcutRow: the 'scrolled' state (pane state, not a row state).
